sloka: उपस्पर्शनकाले तु पान्तु त्वाम् रघुन्ददन ।सर्व लोक प्रभुर् ब्रह्मा भूत भर्ता तथा ऋषयः ॥२-२५-२५॥
transliteration: upasparśanakāle tu pāntu tvām raghundadana ।sarva loka prabhur brahmā bhūta bhartā tathā ṛṣayaḥ ॥2-25-25॥

translations.english: May Siva, lord of all the worlds, Visnu, supporter of living beings, Brahma, rishis and all the rest of the gods protect you while you dwell in the forest
